# 01 用户注册 - 技术设计

## 伪代码

```text
FUNCTION register(email, password):
  IF NOT valid(email): RETURN Err(invalid_email)   // B01-01
  BEGIN TRANSACTION
    INSERT users                                    // B01-02
    INSERT balances                                 // B01-03
  COMMIT OR ROLLBACK BOTH                           // B01-04
```
